players.product: High-k ALD precursor materials for advanced DRAM; photoacid generators and metallic compounds for EUV / advanced photoresists

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (year ended March 31, 2026): net sales, operating profit, ordinary profit and profit attributable to owners of parent all set record highs. By segment, Chemicals sales fell 1.7% (Polymer Additives down 6.7%, Semiconductor Materials up 5.8%, Environmental Materials up 1.8%), Food rose 0.6% and Life Science rose 11.8%.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 416,563 million (+2.3%); operating profit JPY 41,614 million (FY2025: JPY 41,010 million); ordinary profit JPY 42,772 million; segment net sales (100 million yen): Chemicals 2,148, Polymer Additives 984, Semiconductor Materials 360, Environmental Materials 803, Food 830, Life Science 1,117

quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor Materials, FY2026 (higher sales, lower profit): sales of semiconductor lithography materials for advanced photoresists were strong on wider adoption of EUV exposure tools and growing demand for PFAS-free materials; high-k material sales turned upward from the third quarter on shipments of new products for the start of latest-generation DRAM production, and were solid for the full year. Fixed costs rose on up-front investment such as added R&D staff and a new production plant.
quarterly_data.figure: Semiconductor Materials net sales 360 (100 million yen), +5.8%; operating profit 74 (100 million yen), down 17.7%

quarterly_data.signal: Capex plans (finalised as of March 31, 2026, self-funded): new semiconductor materials production facility at the Kashima Chemical Plant (Kamisu, Ibaraki), scheduled start April 2026 and completion June 2027; new research building at the Kuki Development Laboratory (Kuki, Saitama), April 2024 to June 2026. During FY2026 the company decided to build a new plant at the Kashima Chemical Plant for metallic compounds for metal oxide resists for next-generation EUV lithography, completed a new research building at the Kuki laboratory, and started operating epoxy resin adhesive production equipment for automotive electronic components at the Mie Plant.
quarterly_data.figure: Kashima semiconductor materials facility: planned investment JPY 5,180 million (JPY 41 million paid), April 2026 to June 2027; Kuki research building: JPY 12,340 million (JPY 10,529 million paid)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 capital expenditure; in the Chemicals segment mainly additive raw-material tank installation at AMFINE CHEMICAL CORPORATION.
quarterly_data.figure: Capex JPY 21,674 million (Chemicals JPY 15,612 million, Food JPY 2,022 million, Life Science JPY 3,419 million, other JPY 841 million)

quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor materials R&D in FY2026: memory - developing ALD materials for leading-edge DRAM (finer geometry, higher capacity, lower power) and work for stable supply of new products; logic - joint development of new ALD materials with an industry-leading company and semiconductor equipment makers, anticipating changes in transistor and interconnect structures; lithography - adoption of photoacid generators for EUV resists and of MOR, a next-generation resist material, expanded; back-end - heat-dissipating resin sheets, insulating adhesive film and copper paste are progressing in evaluation at users.

Management outlook for FY2027 (year ending March 2027): the company's main target, the semiconductor field, is on an expanding trend in advanced memory and logic on AI and data-center investment. Every reportable segment is expected to post higher sales and profit; for Semiconductor Materials the company cites expanded sales of high-k materials and semiconductor lithography materials, stronger R&D from the new research building coming on line, and production capacity additions.

Middle East situation: some products use naphtha-derived raw materials; with tensions in the Middle East some raw materials are currently tight, but the company expects to maintain its supply system for the time being, and says rising raw-material and packaging prices or supply-chain disruption could follow, which it would seek to offset by passing costs on to product prices, but which could have some impact on its business and results.
Customer concentration: no customer accounts for 10% or more of consolidated net sales. FY2026 net sales by customer location: Japan, China, other Asia, other.
quarterly_data.figure: Japan JPY 189,997 million; China JPY 35,030 million; other Asia JPY 76,149 million; other JPY 115,386 million; total JPY 416,563 million
